About Tush Beauty Spa

A quieter, more personal kind of beauty appointment

Tush Beauty Spa was created for people who want their time in the chair to feel like their own. Every appointment begins with listening: what you would like, how you like to feel, and how much time you have.

From there, your treatment is shaped around you, in a calm space where you can slow down, be looked after, and leave feeling like yourself, only more rested.

Our approach

Why clients choose us

Thoughtful care, from hello to goodbye

  • Personal, unhurried care

    Each visit starts with a conversation about what you would like, so your appointment is shaped around you.

  • A calm, welcoming space

    A soft, comfortable setting designed to help you relax from the moment you arrive.

  • Simple booking

    Send a request in a minute. We will get back to you personally to confirm a time that suits you.

How booking works

Three simple steps

  1. 01

    Choose your treatment

    Browse the menu, or tell us what you have in mind if you are unsure.

  2. 02

    Send a request

    Share your preferred date and time using the short booking form.

  3. 03

    We confirm personally

    We will get back to you to confirm your appointment. Your time is not booked until we do.

Book your visit

Make time for yourself

Tell us what you have in mind and when suits you best. We will be in touch to confirm your appointment.
